title: Enewetak Atoll 2005-09-01, EO-1 bands 10-8-2-1, 15m resolution, no annotations.png
author: NASA
credit: NASA EO-1 satellite image GeoTIFF archive, http://glovis.usgs.gov
description: Composite "false color" multispectral satellite image of Enewetak Atoll, Marshall Islands. NASA EO-1 ALI bands used were 10 (SWIR), 8 (SWIR) and 2 (blue). The image was pan-sharpened and resampled to 15m resolution. Imagery courtesy of NASA/USGS.
